notes.title: UI Overhaul & Dining Points (DP) Update
notes.content:
Sorry everyone for the delayed updates! Due to many life events, development got put on the back burner, but I am back at it and planning for some major CONTENT updates for the upcoming Spring Sale.

Update Notes:
[list]
[*] MAJOR back end code overhaul in preparation for future updates, including potentially multiplayer in the future.
[*] New intuitive side menu at the start screen, including easy-access leaderboard, settings, and new locations.
[*] New points system implemented in preparation for the next update. Allows you to collect "DP Coins" after each round based on well you score. "DP Coins" will be used to purchase free in-game customizations and goodies!
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed missing text characters for KR/JP/CN languages - Part 1/2
notes.content:
[h3]Leaderboard Foreign & Symbols Text Patch[/h3]
This patch fixes the majority of the display issue with symbols, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese characters on the global leaderboard.

Note:
There are still some Chinese characters missing, which will be fixed in the next patch.

Thank you,
Juyoung

notes.title: New Spooky Halloween Content!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954021/645feccbb0d99099cc7043b7def87199caf9bbf3.png[/img]
[h2]New Content for the Official Early Access Launch![/h2]
I hope you aren't afraid of ghosts because in celebration of the Early Access release of Korean BBQ Simulator this coming Friday, October 14th, new Halloween content has been introduced into the game that adds challenging new mechanics, cute ghosts, and new a cosmetic skin for the restaurant menu. 

Check out the official trailer to get a preview of the new contents:

[previewyoutube=F7EKGsgy_Hk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Over the next 2-3 months I will be continue adding in more phone mini-games, achievements, and levels with unique mechanics. The Space level and the Halloween level are examples of the new content that I plan on continuing to release post launch, as well. I hope you enjoy what I have so far and I'll work hard to make more enjoyable, unique experiences for the Korean BBQ enthusiasts out there.

Thank you again for everyone's support. It's been an absolutely wonderful journey together so far and an absolute honor to create a game that highlights and not only promotes awareness of Korean cuisine, but also a style of food that is enjoyed by many countries around the world!

I look forward to continuing our journey as I continue to publish new content for this game and create new games for everyone to enjoy!

As always, Happy grilling!

- Juyoung

notes.title: Early Access Launching This October 14th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954021/ec7dbd734ba6c7807a471903551bbdb81bf5582f.png[/img]
I'm proud to announce that Korean BBQ Simulator will be launching in Early Access this coming October 14th! Early Access is only recommended for those who just can't wait to grill in the full version of the game coming out in the next few months.

With the majority of the core game finished, all that's left is to continue adding new content over the next 2-3 months, including new levels with special mechanics, free in-game cosmetics, and just overall polishing of the experience.

Try competing with each other for the top spot on the leaderboard in Arcade more, or just relax to the ASMR of grilling meats in All-You-Can-Eat mode.

Whichever mode you prefer, I hope you enjoy the game and happy grilling!

- Juyoung
